programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: Mildred Hayes, a hard-nosed mother is seeking justice for her murdered daughter. With no arrests after seven months, Mildred puts up three roadside signs to goad Ebbing police chief into action. But the law - and especially Sam Rockwell's hot-headed deputy - don't take kindly to the provocation. And the townsfolk are on their side. But Mildred doesn't care about ruffling a few feathers. In fact, she's happy to pluck the whole bird.

programme.desc: Historian Dan Jones tells the story of the Wars of the Roses, a 30-year civil war between the House of York and House of Lancaster during which the crown changed hands seven times. Using a combination of documentary and drama, he begins by looking at the reasons for the start of the conflict, revealing it was not caused by scheming Yorkists and belligerent Lancastrians trying to snatch the crown, but by two people fighting to preserve the rule of the ineffective King Henry VI - his smart French wife Margaret of Anjou and his powerful cousin Richard, Duke of York

programme.title: Britain's Bloody Crown

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Pataakha
programme.desc: Badki and Chhutki are two sisters who constantly keep fighting with one another. However, when they get married, they understand each other's importance and build a stronger bond.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Khwaja Mere Khwaja
programme.desc: The plot follows the downfall of the Quadri family due to betrayal and their subsequent pursuit of peace.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: S4 E23 — The Lost Gold of WWIIExplore the top theories behind what happened to the treasure looted by the Japanese during World War II.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: S4 E3 — The Assassination of JFKThe assassination of President John F Kennedy in November 1963. A suspect was captured, but investigators and amateur sleuths still entertain alternative theories.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed with Danny Trejo
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Mysterious StructuresThe presenter explores the world's most significant discoveries and the unexpected ways they were found. He begins by uncovering strange structures - from a revolutionary war era ship hiding under the streets of Manhattan, to a sprawling Roman villa unearthed in the backyard of an English home. Plus, the ancient Grecian maze long thought to be a myth.

programme.title: Medieval Murder Mysteries
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Juan Borgia: A Death in the DynastyThis episode revisits Rome in 1497, when a richly attired but brutally mutilated body was pulled from the Tiber River. He would soon be identified as one Borgia, a son of the head of the Holy Roman Empire Pope Alexander the Sixth. Stabbed as many as eight times and his throat slashed, this was no random attack. Here, modern experts try to identify his killer.

programme.title: What on Earth?
programme.desc: S5 E15An exploration of an atomic tomb, multi-million dollar wacky races and a vision of the countryside on fire.

programme.title: What on Earth?
programme.desc: S5 E16Find the billion-dollar horde buried deep beneath the deserts of Utah, discover the massacre so horrific it was captured from space and see the ice cave of the Norse fire God.

programme.title: Strange Evidence
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Curse of the Mayan TreasureCameras capture city folk's panic and horror as a weird object lights up the Los Angeles sky and seems to behave with a creepy intelligence. Deep in the Mexican jungle, an archaeologist is attacked by an underwater cloud as he dives for treasure at a Mayan sacrificial site.

programme.title: Discovered by Disaster
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Footprints and Ghost ShipsWhy footprints discovered after a storm are altering English migration history by revealing evidence of early human activity that was previously hidden by the landscape. Such discoveries, often exposed by storm surges and erosion, are providing new insights into who was in England thousands of years ago and how they moved around. Plus, clues are unravelled to Maya political intrigue in Guatemala.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S3 E1 — Wigan PierTony Robinson embarks on another expedition through some of Britain's most historic landscapes. He begins with a towpath exploration of industrial engineering along the Leeds and Liverpool Canal. Setting off from Liverpool, he takes a three-day walk inland to Wigan, ending at the town's iconic pier as he traces the story of the waterway's chaotic construction and its impact on the development of Lancashire.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S3 E2 — The Dark Age of NorthumbriaTony Robinson explores the history of the ancient kingdom on a walk from Melrose in the Scottish Borders to Holy Island off the coast of Northumberland. Over five days, he goes on the trail of one of Northumbria's greatest sons - Saint Cuthbert. Through the Tweed Valley and across the Cheviot Hills, it's a journey through a murky history laden with myth. However, by investigating the communities, power bases and landscape of seventh-century Northumbria, Tony aims to understand the pagan land in which Cuthbert spread his simple brand of Celtic Christianity.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S9 E12 — Stoke 4David Dickinson and the team head to Stoke-on-Trent to help members of the public to sort the treasures from their trash. programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: ...Moose/Radar Bear/Zorbing Lemmings/Air Trafficking/A Lemmings Fairy Tale/Slam Dunk Lemmings/Uncouth Bear. Grizzy happens onto an old American India medallion bearing the symbol of the wind. He who wears it has the power to command air streams. / A magic Amerindian top modifies the mental age of anyone who watches it spin. From now on Grizzy has the mind of a 10-month old baby. / A magic horn lands on the muzzle of a moose endowing it with grace and the ability to fly. It soars off leaving a rainbow-colored streak in its wake. / While looking for the TV remote-control device, Grizzy happens onto a box that can localize a bunch of keys thanks to its key ring, which is equipped with a tracker. / The Lemmings have turned the cabin topsy-turvy and created an obstacle course to race through in a hamster ball. / The Lemmings create a customized hang-glider using a supermarket shopping cart for the nacelle and a ventilator as an engine. / The Lemmings scribble all over the book Snow White. / Grizzy and the Lemmings' favorite chocolate spread brand is organizing a big competition where the prize is a giant jar of spread. / Freed from the ice which had preserved him for millions of years a saber-toothed bear bursts into the cabin starving to death

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.sub-title: What a Stinker/Compost to Go/Dare for more/A day with Starmush/The Mysterious Seepod

programme.title: Aladdin

Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: A Goofy Movie
programme.desc: The Disney cartoon dog takes his son on an old-fashioned fishing trip in an attempt to bond with the lad. However, young Max has boasted to his pals that he is going to a pop concert in Los Angeles, and has a few ideas on how to trick his dopey dad. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Through the steadfast support of her older sister and supportive trainers, Trudy Ederle overcomes adversity to rise through the ranks of the Olympic swimming team. She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: While scavenging items from a derelict space station, a group of young colonisers fight for survival when they cross paths with lethal life forms. Co-writer/director Fede Alvarez's horror sequel set between the events of Alien and Aliens, starring Cailee Spaeny, David Jonsson and Isabela Merced.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Single man Frank Adler attempts to raise his child prodigy niece, Mary. However, his plans for a normal school life for the youngster are foiled when the youngster's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn. Drama, starring Chris Evans, Lindsay Duncan and Mckenna Grace.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. She joins them in their acts of sabotage, but finds her loyalties changing as she forms connections with members of the group. Thriller, starring Brit Marling, Elliot Page and Alexander Skarsgard.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Piglet's Big Movie
programme.desc: The plucky porker is upset when his friends tell him he is too small to come honey-harvesting with them, so he embarks on an adventure of his own - and it is not long before his pals start to miss him and realise just how important he is. Animation, featuring the voices of John Fiedler, Jim Cummings and Andre Stojka.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Aladdin

Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: Freaky Friday
programme.desc: A rebellious teenage girl is shocked to learn her mother is planning on getting married again, but soon sees things from her parent's perspective when they magically swap bodies. As the mortified mum rediscovers the highs and lows of adolescence and her daughter gets to grips with working life, they finally begin to understand each other. Comedy remake, with Jamie Lee Curtis and Lindsay Lohan.

programme.title: Spy
programme.desc: A deskbound CIA agent provides valuable background support for a dashing secret agent, but has never gone into action herself. Everything changes, when the spy mysteriously vanishes, and she leaps into action to take his place, infiltrating the inner circle of a ruthless arms dealer and trying to avert a global catastrophe. Comedy adventure, starring Melissa McCarthy, Jason Statham and Rose Byrne.

programme.title: Let's Be Cops
programme.desc: Two friends go to a fancy-dress party as police officers, and are amazed by how people on the street react to their uniforms. They decide to pose as cops in the hope of enjoying the perks of the job, but soon end up in over their heads with gangsters and corrupt members of the real force. Comedy, starring Jake Johnson and Damon Wayans Jr.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: Flubber
programme.desc: A scatty professor is in financial trouble, and his only hope of avoiding disaster is to market his latest invention - a strange rubbery substance with a life of its own. However, a criminal gang is determined to get hold of his creation. Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: A Bug's Life

Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: S3 E15 — Weird AlAdam plans to reignite his fading relationship with Dana by taking her to a concert. Barry and Erica worry that Murray may be feeling depressed.

programme.title: Hollyoaks: Omnibus

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: E74Mercedes returns home to a shock, and Gemma blackmails Jenson. Elsewhere, a resident has a big decision to make.

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back

From a 'better-than-the-chippie' homemade fish supper, to marvellous mussels and tempting Thai fish curries, the girls discover the edible delights that can be found at their fishmongers.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers' Comfort Food
programme.desc: S1 E9 — A Cut AboveThe Bikers take everyday ingredients and transform them into comforting dishes that are both satisfying and surprising. Bananas are transformed into a sophisticated tarte tatin, and some simple ricotta cheese is the basis for gnudi - light, delicious Italian dumplings.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: S2 E9 — Fancy for LessKardea invites her notoriously frugal Aunt TC over for a dinner that looks like a million dollars but won't break the bank. For their fancy meal at home, Kardea makes molasses salmon, mushroom and pea risotto, and wilted bok choy.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Birthday DinnerKardea hosts a birthday dinner for her good friend Ashley, starting with pepper jelly meatballs, followed by low country crab cakes topped with Southern succotash and toasted coconut cake for dessert.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: S1 E5Jamie creates a cracking vegetarian feast with an array of fragrant and fabulous dishes, including a coconut squash curry, beautifully fried golden paneer and smoky aubergine dal.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S6 E11 — Rehearsal DinnerThe delightful Ina Garten reveals her cooking secrets. A future bride is having a dessert dilemma. Ina prepares two perfect puddings for the rehearsal dinner to help her choose.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S6 E12 — Thank You DinnerProvencal soup and seafood platters with sauces.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E1 — CakesTen passionate home bakers take part in a 'bake off', which will test every aspect of their baking skills as they battle it out to be crowned the Great British Bake Off's Best Amateur Baker. Each week the bakers are put through three challenges. The competition kicks off with cake in the Cotswolds. The bakers tackle three increasingly difficult challenges, starting off with their signature bake.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E2 — BiscuitsMel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins take the eight passionate home bakers who made it through the first round to Scone Palace near Perth to make biscuits and teatime treats.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E13 — CamargueJames's culinary tour takes him to the Camargue, where he learns all about the Camargue bull and the delicate hand-harvested salty crust fleur de sel.

programme.desc: Returning champion Aktar Islam, Daniel Clifford's protégé Mark Poynton and ambitious newcomer Jason Hodnett fight it out for fish course glory. After plating up late last time will Aktar manage to be on time today?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Central region chefs Aktar Islam, Mark Poynton and Jason Hodnett go head to head cooking their main courses for the veteran judge. With Mark and Aktar fighting for the lead can Jason sneak under the radar to take them by surprise?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's dessert day and the Central chefs Aktar Islam, Mark Poyton and Jason Hodnett are all striving for one of two spots in the regional final. Will Jason's elaborate chocolate medal dessert see him triumph or sent home empty handed?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Central region chefs cook all four courses again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by special guest judge Max Hastings.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the starter course and as the chefs arrive they discover there's added competition following the London and South East region's shock result. The judges are joined by D-Day veteran George Batts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and those chefs who didn't make it onto the shortlist with their starters are hoping to do better. The judges are joined by Ken Sturdy who landed on Sword Beach on D-Day and who helped judge the North West region.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the half-way point in finals week and those chefs who have yet to get a dish onto the shortlist are feeling the heat. The judges are joined by Baroness Trumpington who worked as a cypher clerk at Bletchley Park from 1941 to 1946.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the last chance for the chefs to get their dish in contention for the final banquet and those who've failed to finish in the top three so far are going all out. Joining the judges is Celia Sandys, Winston Churchill's granddaughter.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the moment of truth as the victorious four must put their finest hours on a plate for those who served both on the front line and the home front, such as D-Day veterans Ken Sturdy and George Batts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three top chefs from Scotland are out to impress this week's veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion. Adam Handling has already won a number of industry awards and is full of confidence. His starter sets out to take the diner on a tour of the UKs best producers. He's up against Michael Bremner, who is hoping to impress with contemporary ingredients including Birch sap and Douglas fir oil. Ally McGrath is celebrating his nation's finest produce and making his very own version of haggis.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach. Also, the highly competitive Adam Handling has been showcasing the finest produce grown and caught in and around the UK in his menu. Once again Michael Bremner is out to show how inventive he can be.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: One chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood, Adam Handling is sticking with his trademark Asian flavours and Ally McGrath is tempering chocolate for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Last year he made the national finals when his starter was shortlisted for the banquet, this year he intends to go one step further and cook at the banquet. One of his rivals last time, Jude Kereama is also back and out to do better than he did previously. The third competitor is newcomer Chris Wheeler who is originally from Swanage in Dorset.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu as the three chefs from the South West tackle the fish course. Chef Josh Eggleton is hoping to impress with an original take on Bolognese, just one of six elements on his complex fish dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head and the South West region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. They are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UK's leading culinary talents, and Kim Woodward who made history when she was appointed Head Chef at the Savoy Grill.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting creative, producing some of the most original and stunning desserts. All three chefs are working in a hot kitchen, the tension is palpable, and this time one chef will go home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are stand out dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is Executive Chef at Berners Tavern in London and Adam Bannister, is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowed Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident, he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister for his modern take on the old boil in the bag fish dinners and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up Wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his 'Cup of Tea for Ma'am'. One of the accompaniments to his earl grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Andrew Scott's worked with the best in the business, and he's concentrating on telling powerful stories as well as delivering perfect flavours. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up Wellington for royalty at many air force banquets. While Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the National Finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head Chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart...and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures warm, deep fried and frozen. And two Michelin starred Mark Froydenlund is planning a novel way to present his dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the all-important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Russell Bateman is creating a beef dish, and Ronnie Murray's mixing a crown of lamb with a curried filling.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for three of London & South East's most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head and the two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award winning food writer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north east regional title but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. Last year, Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. But Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the north east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and wagyu-angus beef - the meat of the day.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. But all is not going to plan and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is Chris McGowan's third time however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's 2 Michelin star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot.The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again, he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the national finals of `Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the national finals of `Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64 year reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. Judging the chefs' dishes are Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton and guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth ll's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: London and South East Mains and Desserts
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: North East Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the topspot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, `Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E5 — OrlaStephen Mulhern hosts as Orla gets her chance to open the iconic red boxes. But in the game show with only one question, will Orla say Deal or No Deal when faced with the Banker's tempting offers.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S12 E82Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S16 E115Bradley Walsh presents as Tom from Liverpool, Jessica from Lincoln, Felix from Ilfracombe and Linda from Lowestoft pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: Emmerdale

programme.title: Coronation Street

programme.title: Murder - Smoke and Lies: True Crime Presents
programme.desc: S1 E10Documentary following the investigation into the death of Nikitta Grender, and the extensive police and forensics work that identified her killer and brought them to justice.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E3 — Gold CoastThe Walshes are halfway through their Australian road trip, and have reached the Gold Coast. Barney has sun, sea and some serious action planned - starting with a trip to the beach, where they join a local outrigger canoe club for a race on the water. Next, the pair visit a wildlife hospital that was set up by the animal-loving Steve Irwin and his family. The duo also learn the art of synchronised swimming and meet a stunt man who has worked alongside some of Hollywood's biggest stars.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E8Adil Ray hosts as Faye Tozer and Lee Latchford-Evans of Steps take on comedian Russell Kane and Big Brother's Will Best to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: S5 E32 — Uruguay v SpainUruguay v Spain (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the third and final match in Group H for both teams, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. These two came into the tournament as the favourites to progress to the knockout rounds, but even if both teams' progression is already guaranteed, they will be eager to make a statement against strong opposition and look to top the group. The nations last met in the group stage of the 2013 FIFA Confederations Cup, when first-half goals by Pedro and Roberto Soldado gave the Spaniards a 2-1 win. That was a match between the reigning European and South American champions at the time, and coming into this encounter Spain are European champions once more after they won that title two years ago, while Uruguay were third in the most recent Copa America held in the United States in 2024. programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: S5 E30 — Norway v FranceNorway v France (Kick-off 8.00pm). All the action from the final match in Group I for both teams, held at Boston Stadium in the USA. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E32 — Uruguay v SpainUruguay v Spain (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the third and final match in Group H for both teams, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. These two came into the tournament as the favourites to progress to the knockout rounds, but even if both teams' progression is already guaranteed, they will be eager to make a statement against strong opposition and look to top the group. The nations last met in the group stage of the 2013 FIFA Confederations Cup, when first-half goals by Pedro and Roberto Soldado gave the Spaniards a 2-1 win. That was a match between the reigning European and South American champions at the time, and coming into this encounter Spain are European champions once more after they won that title two years ago, while Uruguay were third in the most recent Copa America held in the United States in 2024. With analysis from Gary Neville, Juan Mata and Ange Postecoglou.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: S5 E32 — Uruguay v SpainUruguay v Spain (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the third and final match in Group H for both teams, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. These two came into the tournament as the favourites to progress to the knockout rounds, but even if both teams' progression is already guaranteed, they will be eager to make a statement against strong opposition and look to top the group. programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E34 — Panama v EnglandPanama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second-ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first-ever goal at the World Cup finals thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia. With analysis from Roy Keane, Ian Wright and Gary Neville, pitchside inserts from Laura Woods, Emma Hayes and Karen Carney, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. programme.desc: S5 E32 — Uruguay v SpainUruguay v Spain (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the third and final match in Group H for both teams, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. These two came into the tournament as the favourites to progress to the knockout rounds, but even if both teams' progression is already guaranteed, they will be eager to make a statement against strong opposition and look to top the group. The nations last met in the group stage of the 2013 FIFA Confederations Cup, when first-half goals by Pedro and Roberto Soldado gave the Spaniards a 2-1 win. That was a match between the reigning European and South American champions at the time, and coming into this encounter Spain are European champions once more after they won that title two years ago, while Uruguay were third in the most recent Copa America held in the United States in 2024. With analysis from Gary Neville, Juan Mata and Ange Postecoglou.
